title: Design: Dropdown of a customer on an inactive term lists it last
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop switched off Net 50 while a customer is on it, and you compare that customer's term dropdown with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Customer-A} is on Net 50, and Net 50 is deactivated.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-28 Customer.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p6-05-this-customer-s-picker.png, ct-p7-07-edit-vendor-keeps-the-inactive-term.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the customer page of {Customer-A}.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil on the customer card.
  2. Click the "Credit Terms" box.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "Edit Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: the list shows the active terms in the page's order with no "Net 50" among them, then, last, "Net 50 (Inactive)", selected (highlighted). Compare ct-p6-05-this-customer-s-picker.png for the list and ct-p7-07-edit-vendor-keeps-the-inactive-term.png for the last row (the customer drawing is cut off before that row).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R7: “On Edit Customer, a customer whose term was deactivated shows it as "{name} (Inactive)" in the dropdown, selected, listed after the active terms.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
